explicit_limits: Bootstrap is guarded for this exact reviewed module, not automatic support for arbitrary System-NNN versions.
Host wall-clock/startup RNG state must be supplied explicitly; no seed is fabricated.
Unknown opcode/native operation/calculated service remains a visible original-PC boundary.
Packed lookup plans are policy data for host-owned shared archive registries; no VM archive decoder or renderer is provided.
Music .mml semantics and original save reconstruction are not established by these resource names.
No original arbitrary array opcode is invented: inspected SPT values address the native scalar bank and original parameter/continuation tables.
